name: run_ledger_fill_fee_slippage
description: Taker fee plus 10 bps adverse slippage on one buy fill. Slippage raises the entry price above the event price; the fill also sets the mark to the raw event price, so the slippage shows up as negative unrealized at that instant.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. FILL qty=+4 price=100 fee_rate=0.0005 slippage_bps=10: sign(qty)=+1; exec=100*(1+1*10/1e4)=100*1.001=100.1. fee=|4|*1*100.1*0.0005=400.4*0.0005=0.2002; wallet=1000-0.2002=999.7998; fees_cum=0.2002; realized_cum=0. entry=100.1. The fill sets mark=its price=100 (spec: a FILL sets the mark to its price if no MARK is later). unrealized=4*1*(100-100.1)=4*(-0.1)=-0.4. equity=999.7998+(-0.4)=999.3998. Final: wallet 999.7998, unrealized -0.4, equity 999.3998, realized 0, fees 0.2002, funding 0, position +4.
